**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

No MFN obligation burdens us anywhere in the Agreement. I searched for "most favoured nation", "no less favourable/favorable", "favorable", and non-discrimination/equal-access language; the single comparative-terms provision is Subparagraph 15.2, which obliges the **Terminal Parties** to furnish transiting facilities to the Parties on terms no less favorable than those granted to another Carrier. That MFN runs in our favour as a capacity holder — Teleglobe USA Inc. holds no Terminal Station or Cable Landing Point and so is not a Terminal Party obligor. Paragraphs 16.2 and 17.1–17.3 similarly impose only reasonable, non-discriminatory arrangements on Terminal Parties.

Per the playbook (MFN pricing in Customer's favour is welcome), no redline was proposed.
